config.objective: H946 natural native/random effects + equal-task discovery-anchor effectMSE; add lambda*sum_j[(E_j+1e-12)^.25-1e-3], E_j=mean across tasks of sum squared whole-product finite contributions / sum squared teacher effects. Dimensionless, invariant to factor/output scale gauges.
config.why_quarter_power: A sum of contribution norms is unchanged by splitting a product into identical smaller copies. The quarter power of squared norm is concave and penalizes such splitting; smoothing avoids singular derivatives. It is a sparsity surrogate, not exact product count.
config.scope: Complexity charged only on known discovery-anchor interventions, not all states or model storage. Same64products/parameters for all fits. Train from same-seed H946 anchor_effects checkpoint, fresh Adam .003 and matched batches; allfinalfits retained. No evaluation-based selection.
config.evaluation: Natural independent probes and H849 taskeffects; discovery-greedy wholeproduct subsets1..64; no coefficient refit. Full-output causal fidelity remains required before promotion.
